responsibility: Implements tree-SSA address decomposition, folding, and target-aware rebuilding of MEM_REF and TARGET_MEM_REF expressions. This file owns the logic that breaks a memory reference into symbol/base/index/step/offset parts, uses target address-space modes and RTL address-cost/legitimacy checks to reassemble those parts into valid addressing forms, folds constants within TARGET_MEM_REFs, and transfers alias, points-to, dependence-clique, and alignment metadata when references are rewritten, making it the concrete address-lowering support used by IV optimization and other memory-reference transforms rather than a standalone optimization pass.
same_name_distinction: This source file is the implementation side of the tree-SSA address utilities: it contains the actual decomposition, target-aware rebuilding, RTL legality/cost checks, TARGET_MEM_REF folding, and reference-metadata transfer logic. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-address.h, which only defines struct mem_address and declares the API, this file performs the concrete address-lowering work.
